title: Per-config config.json
description: One record per config, at data/batches/<batch>/configs/<config_id>/config.json. Captures the config's identity on the family x model x effort x protocol axes plus billing/auth/transport provenance and its aggregate telemetry + m/N. JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme v12 does not enumerate the JSON shape of config.json (it is named in IMPLEMENTATION-BRIEF §4); field set below is drawn from BRIEF §4 + MODEL-MATRIX axes and the exact object shapes (telemetry, auth) are this contract's design — flagged where invented. schema_version 1.0.0; file SHA256 + version frozen into lock (scheme §11).
$comment: schema_version: 1.1.0. Bumped 1.0.0→1.1.0 (M2, DECISIONS-M0 M1 ruling): `m` changed from a single integer to a PER-VARIANT object {"min":int,"q":int} because scheme §1.1 defines N/m at config×variant granularity and §5 similarity eligibility (cross needs both-side m≥2) is judged per variant. The file-level schema_version lives here (structured $comment) so the lock-population loop (DATA-LAYOUT §4) reads one uniform source across all eleven schema files. cost_usd is a canonical decimal string; tokens/wall_ms are JSON integers.

config_id.description: Canonical config identifier; MUST equal the <config_id> directory name and appear in manifest.config_ids. Ordering authority is the manifest's persisted array (NFC UTF-8 byte order).

family.description: Model family (e.g. gpt / claude / grok / deepseek). Grouping axis for presentation (DESIGN §4.4).

model_id.description: Requested model id as sent to the vendor (the intended model, before served-model verification).

effort.description: Vendor-specific effort/thinking parameter as configured (per-vendor mapping table, BRIEF R3). null when the model exposes no effort axis. Kept as an opaque string because the axis is non-isomorphic across vendors — do NOT enum it.

protocol.description: Delivery protocol arm (scheme §1 / BRIEF §4). agent/cli carry known system-prompt confounds recorded but not corrected (scheme §10). 'app' = an app-only manual tier (e.g. ChatGPT app codex @ultra, fresh session, exact prompts) — added 2026-07-18 for the codex-app arm.

billing.description: metered = pay-per-token; plan = subscription/plan billing (requires vendor_sanction_ref).

auth.description: Auth provenance. NEVER contains a secret — only a reference. Secrets live in env/secret, never in repo (BRIEF §6). JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): object shape is this contract's design.

credential_ref.description: Opaque handle/name of the credential source (e.g. env var name or secret path). Not the secret value.

transport.description: Transport/endpoint arm descriptor (e.g. 'vendor-native-api', 'harness', 'official-bare-endpoint', 'cli'). US arms use ZERO proxy (BRIEF R3).

served_model.description: The model id the vendor reports as actually serving the request (verified per arm, BRIEF R3/R8). null if the vendor exposes no served-model signal. A mismatch vs model_id is a recorded confound, not a silent correction.

vendor_sanction_ref.description: For billing=plan configs: a citation/URL to the vendor endorsement that plan usage is sanctioned for this purpose (BRIEF §4 'vendor sanction'). MUST be non-null when billing=plan; MUST be null when billing=metered (enforced by the conditional below).

telemetry.description: Aggregate telemetry summary across this config's slots (tokens / elapsed / cost, BRIEF §4). JUDGMENT CALL (flagged): scheme does not enumerate telemetry fields; this closed shape is the contract's design. Any value may be null when the vendor does not report it.

prompt_tokens.description: Summed input tokens across valid+billed slots.

total_tokens.description: Summed total tokens; may differ from prompt+completion if vendor bills otherwise.

wall_ms.description: Summed wall-clock request duration in milliseconds.

cost_usd.description: Cost estimate as a canonical decimal string (same grammar as manifest coordinates), or null. String to avoid float drift.

m.description: PER-VARIANT count(valid) for this config in this batch (scheme §1.1; §5 similarity eligibility is judged per variant — DECISIONS-M0 M1 ruling). Each value ≤ N. Drives the per-variant m/N badge and the cross m_a≥2 ∧ m_b≥2 eligibility gate.

min.description: count(valid) for the P-min variant (≤ N).

q.description: count(valid) for the P-q variant (≤ N).

N.description: Slots issued for this config (batch-uniform, must equal manifest.N).
